scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm tiles:lint && pnpm tiles:test
scripts.docker:r:build: docker compose --env-file infrastructure/docker/.env.local -f infrastructure/docker/compose.yaml build analysis-r
scripts.docker:r:bootstrap:build: docker build --target bootstrap -t ecosuitability-analysis-r-bootstrap -f services/analysis-r/Dockerfile services/analysis-r
scripts.docker:r:bootstrap: docker run --rm --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" -e HOME=/tmp -e RENV_PATHS_CACHE=/tmp/renv-cache -v "$PWD/services/analysis-r:/opt/analysis-r" --entrypoint sh ecosuitability-analysis-r-bootstrap -c 'mkdir -p "$HOME/.R" "$RENV_PATHS_CACHE" && Rscript --vanilla scripts/bootstrap-renv.R'
scripts.docker:r:up: docker compose --env-file infrastructure/docker/.env.local -f infrastructure/docker/compose.yaml up -d analysis-r
scripts.docker:r:status: docker compose --env-file infrastructure/docker/.env.local -f infrastructure/docker/compose.yaml ps analysis-r
scripts.docker:r:health: docker compose --env-file infrastructure/docker/.env.local -f infrastructure/docker/compose.yaml exec -T analysis-r Rscript scripts/healthcheck.R
scripts.docker:r:test: docker compose --env-file infrastructure/docker/.env.local -f infrastructure/docker/compose.yaml run --rm --no-deps --entrypoint sh analysis-r -c 'Rscript tests/test-validation.R && Rscript tests/test-raster-assets.R && Rscript tests/test-model.R && Rscript tests/test-run-store.R'
scripts.docker:r:logs: docker compose --env-file infrastructure/docker/.env.local -f infrastructure/docker/compose.yaml logs --follow analysis-r
scripts.tiles:lint: cd services/tiles && uv run --frozen ruff check .
scripts.docker:tiles:build: docker compose --env-file infrastructure/docker/.env.local -f infrastructure/docker/compose.yaml build tiles
scripts.docker:tiles:up: docker compose --env-file infrastructure/docker/.env.local -f infrastructure/docker/compose.yaml up -d tiles
